evals.prompt: A page where buyers search and filter purchase orders and approve several at once.
Show one supplier with general data, contacts and documents, editable, with Save and Cancel.
Let users create an unfamiliar product through four validated steps, review the result, and submit it.

An application frame must keep global search, notifications, profile and product switching around existing business pages, with optional side navigation. Inside the page, group selected-item actions with arrow-key navigation and responsive overflow.
Build an app-entry starting point where users choose a business area using selected navigation and open favorite apps; the app team will provide the tiles.
Keep a searchable record list beside the selected record's details and optionally open a related sub-object in a third column.
Start from examples explaining no data, no results and loading failure with create, clear and retry actions, then adapt the relevant state.
Let the user pick a country from about 200 options by typing to narrow suggestions. Embed the field in a small page.
Pick exactly one of three shipping speeds in a form, keeping all three answers visible for comparison.
Sort and filter 5,000 flat order rows by column in a small page; keep only visible rows rendered and perform filtering in the page.
Tell the user that Save worked in a brief non-disruptive message that disappears. Embed it in a small page with a Save action.
Choose several predefined office locations from 80 options while typing narrows the list; show selected locations as tokens.
Collect several free-form email recipients as caller-validated tokens, with optional suggestions, without a separate search task.
Find supplier values among 800 records by business key, city and description, then select several values or define range conditions.
Browse a hierarchy of departments and teams by expanding and collapsing parent-child nodes, with node selection.
Show an explicit confirmation and a contained editing task that blocks the surrounding page until the user responds.
Show contextual editing near an opener on desktop, but use a full-screen phone dialog because the content exceeds one-third of the phone screen.
Show a compact category marker and the semantic state of an order beside it; neither is a removable selected value.
Switch between distinct content facets on the current object page rather than change a compact view setting or navigate application modules.
Choose arbitrary colors visually or by hexadecimal, RGB and HSL channel entry rather than choose only fixed swatches.
Choose one contiguous Gregorian start/end date interval in a compact field, allowing both direct typing and calendar selection.
Keep a warning visible beside usable page content while users continue working.

Group collapsible information within the current page instead of previewing an independent destination. Give the section a heading, show fully visible read-only body text, and let users reveal a separate lengthy description in place.
Apply a binary form setting immediately when it changes, without waiting for submission or activating a toolbar feature.
Personalize filter-field visibility, order and conditions across fields in a staged dialog before applying them.
Compose one plain application screen with a header bar, scrolling content and footer; do not add structured collapsing header content or object sections.
In a dashboard show measured completion percentages for running uploads, and show a busy state over another operation whose completion percentage is unknown.
